notes.title: [LAUNCH DAY] Jigsaw USA is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey! 

I'm delighted to announce that Jigsaw USA is live! 

This game started as a learning project I took up after releasing my last game ( American Blast). My intention was to learn some new skills for my next game. But unexpectedly, it turned into a full game and a project I am proud of. I'm really happy I get to put this out into the world. 

I want to thank my family and friends for their support and feedback over the last year. I also want to thank everyone that has wishlisted and purchased JIgsaw USA. I hope that you enjoy my game! Thank you!

notes.title: [COUNTDOWN] 15 Days Until Jigsaw USA Launches
notes.notes:
Only 15 days left until I release Jigsaw USA!
Bugs are being squashed and jigs are being sawed. 

[list]
[*] Double-checking leaderboards so they run smoothly from Day 1.
[*] Testing the puzzles to ensure they’re challenging but fun (yes, I still struggle with some of the harder ones!).
[*] Adding those final touches that make the game feel polished and complete.
[/list]

I would greatly appreciate your support. If you haven’t already, adding Jigsaw USA to your Steam Wishlist is a huge help. Not only will it remind you when the game is live, but it also helps more people discover the game.

Thanks you!

notes.title: Unlock the Fun: A Sneak Peek at Jigsaw USA’s Achievement Icons!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m super excited to share something I’ve been working on behind the scenes—achievement icons for Jigsaw USA! 🎉

These icons aren’t just some quick designs; they’re a little piece of love and creativity I poured into the game. Each one represents a milestone you can achieve, and I wanted them to feel as rewarding as the accomplishment itself.

I tried to give them a playful vibe that makes them fun to collect. Whether you’re crushing time records or unlocking every puzzle in a collection, there’s an icon waiting to celebrate your win.

Take a minute to check them out!  I’d love to hear what you think—got a favorite? Let me know in the comments!

Thanks for being part of this journey with me. It’s so cool to share these moments with all of you. And hey, if you haven’t already, make sure to wishlist Jigsaw USA so you don’t miss any updates!

Thank you!
